name: 🚂 Build a Train
desc:
🚂 Build a train and see how far you can go! Purchase new blocks to design and create your own train cart! Try to go as far as possible whilst avoiding different obstacles and enemies.

❓ How to Play:
- 🏪 Buy blocks from shop
- 🔨 Place blocks on train cart
- 💨 Send off your cart for money
- 💸 Continue upgrading your train

❗ NOTE:
- Your train will automatically earn money for you while you are offline, come back every day to collect your earnings!
